@@U04169@@
The right flank’s holding up well;
and there I see the giant Jack 好斗者
towering above all the rest,
doing what he does best.

@@U04171@@
First I saw only one arm raised in battle,
now I see a dozen; it’s not natural.

@@U04173@@
Have you never heard of the streaks of mist
that sweep the coast of Sicily?
Shimmering in the bright light of day,
they rise to the middle air and
there present wondrous visions
mirrored in their own peculiar haze.
Cities are seen swaying this way and that,
and gardens rising and falling,
as image follows image,
appearing, vanishing.

@@U04175@@
Look there!
How very strange!
What’s that light at the tips of my soldiers’
lances? And flames dancing
on the polished spears of our phalanx!
I find it all very mysterious.

@@U04177@@
By your leave, Sire,
those are the traces of spirits now long vanished,
the Dioskouroi, that sailors always swear by,
summoning here the last of their strength.

@@U04179@@
But why should Nature come to aid us
with her most precious gifts?
translation:
@@U04169@@
右翼支撑良好；
在那里我看到了巨人杰克
凌驾于一切之上，
做他最擅长的事。

@@U04171@@
一开始我只看到一只手臂在战斗中举起，
现在我看到了十几个；这不自然。

@@U04173@@
你有没有听说过雾气条纹
横扫西西里岛海岸？
在白天明亮的光线下闪闪发光，
他们升到半空中并且
那里呈现出奇妙的景象
反映在他们自己独特的阴霾中。
城市摇摇欲坠，
和花园的起伏，
如下图所示，
出现，消失。

@@U04175@@
看那儿！
多么奇怪啊！
我的士兵尖端发出的光是什么？
长矛？还有舞动的火焰
在我们方阵抛光的长矛上！
我觉得这一切都很神秘。

@@U04177@@
陛下，请您原谅，
这些是早已消失的灵魂的痕迹，
Dioskouroi，水手们总是发誓的，
在这里召唤他们最后的力量。

@@U04179@@
但为什么大自然要来帮助我们
带着她最珍贵的礼物？
